items.description: Sales funnel and commercial data management via Bitrix CRM. Technical focal point for integrated management systems (DKSoft and Sponte), leading cross-system data migration, contract audits, executive reporting, and staff technical training.

Operations within the Health, Safety and Environment (EHS/SSMA) department of the multinational group. Managed PPE inventory and regulatory compliance, consolidated performance KPIs for internal audits, and maintained corporate intranet/RELATE records.

Design and end-to-end development of scalable software ecosystems. Architected Safe Finance (Turborepo fintech monorepo with 18 FSD modules, Clean Architecture, Convex, and concurrent processing of >100 transactions) and EcoVolt (B2B solar energy intelligence platform with interactive ROI simulator and weather forecasting integration).
Higher education focusing on advanced algorithms, relational and non-relational database modeling (SQL and NoSQL), modern software engineering, distributed architectures, and agile execution.
